[h1]ACHIEVEMENTS PATCH[/h1]

Earlier today, [b]FunkeymonkeyTTR[/b] reported that the [b]Achievements[/b] were not unlocking properly. The game was actually not guaranteeing the Achievements to be unlocked, and was failing at unlocking a lot of them on the way.
